programmes.show_description: The Quality of Mercy: Detective drama. When Lewis and Hathaway investigate the murder of a rising Oxford theatre star, they soon focus their suspicions on his acting colleagues.
On the Omnibuses: Sitcom about a bus driver and his conductor pal. The company celebrates its centenary.

The Battle of Deveraux Dale: Classic British sitcom. Lady Deveraux asks Simon and Oliver to take part in a historical re-enactment of a Civil War battle at the village fete.
Goodbye Stan: Sitcom about a bus driver and his conductor pal. Stan gets a job up north and decides to get himself sacked in order to earn an extra week's wages.

Sally plans the decor for her new home while Claire has second thoughts about the deal. Harry is visited by his ex-wife Clarissa and Michelle returns from Ireland.

Witch Hunt: Police drama series set in the 1960s. Nick investigates a report by three children who claim to have seen a witch vandalising a funeral urn.
